title: TurnComposer
description: What the person chose in the chat composer's mode and chips, sent beside the words of one written chat turn. A hint the model reads, never a route: the hub checks it against the person's own band and offered tools, and ignores it on a spoken, robot, satellite or shared turn.

mode.description: The mode id from GET /api/composer/modes, for example `picture`, `video` or `song`. `ask` (plain chat) carries no hint.

settings.description: The chip values the person picked, keyed by the chip's state id (`shape`, `count`, `quality`). The hub keeps only keys and values the mode offers this person; an unknown or out-of-range entry is dropped.

cast.description: Cast ids the person added with @. The hub keeps only the ids this person may cast. Never logged.
